description: Angular component for a slider widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling UI rendering, styling, and interactions for a customizable slider.

classes.name: SliderWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a customizable slider widget with dynamic styling, resize handling, and value management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, styles, and value getters.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up resize observer for auto-scaling after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and CSS styles on component destruction.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Additional initialization, sets border radius style.

methods.name: onSliderChange
methods.description: Handles slider value change, updates value and triggers value setter.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Updates internal value and display text.

methods.name: updateValueText
methods.description: Formats and updates the display text for current value.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts scaling and layout based on container size.
